mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.code_runner_configs ( id, question_id, schema_version, contract_id, contract_version, contract_status, title, statement, execution_profile_id, execution_profile_version, archetype_id, archetype_version, comparator_id, comparator_version, entry_point, signature_json, starter_code, banned_api_patterns_json, reference_solution, revision, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{questionId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{contractId}, #{contractVersion}, #{contractStatus}, #{title}, #{statement}, #{executionProfileId}, #{executionProfileVersion}, #{archetypeId}, #{archetypeVersion}, #{comparatorId}, #{comparatorVersion}, #{entryPoint}, CAST(#{signatureJson} AS jsonb), #{starterCode}, CAST(#{bannedApiPatternsJson} AS jsonb), #{referenceSolution}, #{revision}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO edu.code_runner_test_cases ( id, code_runner_config_id, external_test_id, category, visibility, arguments_json, expected_output_json, points, ordinal, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{configId}, #{externalTestId}, #{category}, #{visibility}, CAST(#{argumentsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{expectedOutputJson} AS jsonb), #{points}, #{ordinal}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, schema_version, contract_id, contract_version, contract_status, title, statement, execution_profile_id, execution_profile_version, archetype_id, archetype_version, comparator_id, comparator_version, entry_point, signature_json::text AS signature_json, starter_code, banned_api_patterns_json::text AS banned_api_patterns_json, reference_solution, revision FROM edu.code_runner_configs WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT external_test_id, category, visibility, arguments_json::text AS arguments_json, expected_output_json::text AS expected_output_json, points, ordinal FROM edu.code_runner_test_cases WHERE code_runner_config_id = #{configId} ORDER BY ordinal
